title: Story premise ENT046: The Returning Picnic Table
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (block-world chain reactions). Hook: The park is hiding our lunch furniture. Takeaway/theme: A deployment sequence can give emptied spaces a second purpose.
description: A block family needs a picnic table on a bare square, but every piece is stored beneath a different paving tile. Opening the first compartment raises a leg that unlocks the next compartment; the final tabletop rotates into place, and the now-empty compartments become matching seats.
